## Government & development

- Greater Bengaluru Development Minister Krishna Byre Gowda on 2 November directed officials to fully digitise Bengaluru's Transferable Development Rights (TDR) system on one online platform covering GBA and BDA; the software is expected to go live in about 10 days. — [Elets eGov](https://egov.eletsonline.com/2026/11/bengaluru-tdr-digitisation/) (2026-11-03)
